parts.text: Which choice uses shared life characteristics rather than one visible sign?

options.text: The spinach is living because it grows and shows other life processes; the dormant wheat grain can be living if it can grow when conditions suit; the marble only rolls and is not living.
The dry wheat grain is dead because it is not moving right now.
The glass marble is living because it moves when it rolls.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Anaya finds a dry dormant wheat grain, a growing spinach seedling in a pot, and a glass marble near the garden. She wants to decide which is living.

part_answers.answer: Living status rests on shared life characteristics. A dormant seed can still be living; motion alone does not make a marble living.

teacher.key_rationale: Living beings share life characteristics. Dormant seeds can still be living; rooted spinach is living; rolling alone does not make a marble living.
